entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I...
Yeah, hi. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes. Order number is VF-881-9240.

Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up that order... VF-881-9240. I see the shoes were delivered about 74 days ago. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
They just don't work for me. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting painful blisters after every ride. I just want a refund.
I understand, getting blisters is definitely no good. I've just checked our policy, and for these cycling shoes, you are well within the 90-day return window.
So you can process the refund? Yes or no?

Yes, absolutely. I've just approved the return on my end. I'm sending a confirmation email to you now with a prepaid shipping label. Just attach that to the box and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
